title: Los Alamos–Battelle Nitinol contract of 1949
place_text: Los Alamos, New Mexico / Battelle Memorial Institute

tellings.quote: veterans of World War II. Some of the most interesting evidence I found for Roswell is actually that there was a contract between Los Alamos and Battelle Memorial Institute in 1949

related.note: Both are the 1949 Battelle contract that led to Nitinol and is offered as Roswell evidence. This telling makes Los Alamos the other party, where the story says Wright Field.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that some of the most interesting evidence he has found for Roswell, the 1947 claim that a crashed craft was recovered in New Mexico, is a 1949 contract between Los Alamos, the New Mexico nuclear weapons lab, and the Battelle Memorial Institute, a research organisation. He links the contract to Nitinol, a nickel and titanium metal that returns to its original shape. To Michels, it would suggest that strange material from a crash was being studied.
